name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 158 drones 16 Nov; Dnipro city lost power
summary: Russia launched 158 drones at Ukraine overnight into 16 Nov; strikes on energy sites left Dnipro without power
state: Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 158 drones overnight into 16 Nov, 131 of which were downed, with impacts at 19 locations (ABC News). Through 16 Nov, local authorities reported deaths in Dnipro, Chernihiv and Balakliia; DTEK said Dnipro lost all power that evening, and the death toll from the 2 Nov strike on Komyshuvakha rose to 72 (Ukrinform). Russia said it downed 1,336 Ukrainian drones the same night. No ceasefire has been agreed, and sustained mass strikes on energy infrastructure keep the Alert.
for_you: Severe power and heating outages are affecting Dnipro, Kharkiv, Poltava, Zaporizhzhia and Odesa regions. The FCDO advises against all travel to Ukraine. Airports in western Russia have faced temporary restrictions during drone attacks.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes: 158 drones on 16 Nov with energy outages; Komyshuvakha toll 72 = Alert
